name: io.github.arunmk-ms/dicom-agent-mcp
title: DICOM Agent
description: Search, retrieve, store, view, measure and de-identify DICOM images over DIMSE and DICOMweb.

packageArguments.name: --node
packageArguments.description: DICOM node: name=dimse://AE_TITLE@host:port or name=https://server/dicom-web, with optional ;read-only ;token-env=VAR ;user=NAME;password-env=VAR. Repeatable.

packageArguments.name: --storage-dir
packageArguments.description: Local cache for retrieved files and renders. Defaults to ~/.dicom-agent-mcp/cache.

packageArguments.name: --allow-path
packageArguments.description: Extra directory the local-file and pixel tools may read. Repeatable.

packageArguments.name: --calling-ae
packageArguments.description: AE title this server uses for DIMSE. Defaults to DICOM_MCP.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_DICOM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for a DICOMweb node configured with token-env=AZURE_DICOM_TOKEN. Use any variable name you reference in --node.

environmentVariables.name: DICOM_AGENT_MCP_DEID_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret that makes de-identification pseudonyms and UIDs consistent across calls.
